Definition: properly, a whisper, i.e. by implication, (in a good sense) a private prayer, (in a bad one) an incantation; concretely, an amulet
BiblicalUsage: 1) whispering, charming; 1a) serpent-charming; 1b) charms, amulets (worn by women); 1c) whisper (of prayer)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
